analysis_protocol.bootstrap_interval: paired percentile 95% interval with linear interpolation; hard gate uses p97.5
analysis_protocol.combined_bootstrap: resample within language x duration-bin strata, preserving all six cell counts
analysis_protocol.normalization: Unicode NFKC; casefold; map Russian ё to е; map Unicode punctuation/symbol/separator/control to spaces; collapse whitespace. WER splits on spaces; CER removes spaces.
analysis_protocol.one_shot: The evaluator atomically creates a consumed receipt before scoring and refuses if either receipt or report exists. It may run only after complete immutable shipping/candidate JSONLs and metadata are sealed; partial scoring, subset selection, optional stopping, and metric-driven reruns are prohibited.
analysis_protocol.scoring: micro WER/CER from summed edit errors and frozen reference lengths; combined, language, and duration-bin paired bootstrap intervals; per-utterance regression distribution; exact-text token/word timing and confidence alignment; vocabulary outcome false negatives

decision_rule.blocked_state: No ASR/CoreML inference is permitted from this preregistration. First materialize the frozen 180-row Common Voice selection as complete genuine utterances, freeze a deterministic MP3-to-16k-f32le canonicalizer and all source/PCM hashes, then run the frozen sealer to create an armed preregistration.
decision_rule.changes_after_arming: Any corpus row, reference, PCM byte, exclusion set, evaluator, threshold, normalization, product config, or analysis change requires a new versioned preregistration and a genuinely untouched corpus.
decision_rule.final: INTEGRATE only if every hard gate is true; otherwise REJECT. Engineering and prior holdout data must never be pooled into the result.

hard_gate_interpretation.cer: CER and paired CER intervals are mandatory report fields but are not separate acceptance gates.
hard_gate_interpretation.duration_bins: 1-2 means 1.000 <= seconds < 2.000; 2-3 means 2.000 <= seconds < 3.000; 3-4 means 3.000 <= seconds <= 4.000, based on canonical PCM sample count.
hard_gate_interpretation.per_utterance: Any candidate-minus-shipping word-error delta >=2 is an immediate failure.
hard_gate_interpretation.token_structure: Both paths must have zero structural/emission failures. Exact-text SequenceMatcher alignment is matched/max(shipping_count,candidate_count); aligned p95 start/end and confidence limits apply separately to tokens and words.
hard_gate_interpretation.vocabulary_false_negative: Shipping outcome is a vocabulary candidate/rescored outcome while candidate path has no vocabulary candidate outcome.

product_config.summary: mel=false, concurrency=4, TDT maxTokens=600, dualDecode=false, resetData=false, computeUnits=.all, vocabulary enabled with frozen 28 terms, per-fixture language hints

provenance_caveat.common_voice_access: The pinned, anonymously accessible fsicoli/common_voice_17_0 artifact is an unofficial mirror of Mozilla Common Voice 17.0. Its README at the pinned commit declares CC0-1.0 and contains EN/RU. The official Hugging Face repository now contains only a migration notice to Mozilla Data Collective. The corpus remains blocked until raw audio hashes and canonical PCM hashes are materialized and sealed; do not treat metadata availability alone as official-byte attestation.
provenance_caveat.forced_derivation: Utterance trimming, transcript truncation, forced alignment, generated references, and duration fabrication are forbidden.

run_contract.candidate_selection_requirement: Before any inference, seal exact model paths and SHA-256 identities, runner binary, shared weights, product config, final manifest, and output destinations in immutable run metadata.
required_same_behavior: same frozen PCM bytes and fixture order
same product config except the explicitly declared candidate artifact

scope.fleurs_availability_audit: Pinned FLEURS train/test maximum is 18 EN and 12 RU, all in 3-4s; the frozen language-balanced core is 12+12.
scope.holdout_role: Future one-shot acceptance of a candidate short path versus shipping on exactly balanced genuine 1-4s EN/RU utterances.
scope.supplement_role: Frozen metadata-only Common Voice selection supplies 34/34/22 per language for 1-2/2-3/3-4; with the 12 FLEURS 3-4s rows this yields 34 per bin and 102 per language.
